positions.title: Senior Design Industrial Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Created a fishbone diagram and applied process mapping to identify all possible causes of product failure, which enabled further analysis of the current rework process, personnel, parts, and equipment. 
•	Developed SQL queries to determine the number of product failures, returns, cycle times, and operator variability within a two year time frame.
•	Utilized Minitab and Microsoft Excel to run statistical analysis, indicating that rework cycle times would be significantly decreased if products are scrapped after an optimal number of reworks loops.
•	Calculated the total cost of the current rework process by comparing the average rework cost per minute and cycles times, and ensured accuracy by performing time studies on rework technicians to compare real cycle times versus inputted system cycle times.
•	Executed a Gage R&R study to determine if there was variability between inspectors, parts, or equipment, which revealed that parts contributed to the number of appearing product failures due to a poorly defined work instruction.

positions.title: Industrial Engineer I Intern
positions.description:
•	Applied six sigma DMAIC methodology to identify if there was a correlation between available installation dates and the company’s sales fulfillment rate, resulting in statistical projection of increase in customer satisfaction.
•	Calculated potential loss of revenue from losing customers due to installation availability and determined that over an average of 7% of customers will not install services if their scheduled date is past 4 days out. 
•	Researched caller issues with the interactive voice response (IVR) system and calculated the cost of repeated calls.

projects.title: Arizona State University: Simulating Stochastic Systems course, PetSmart Arena Model, 2014
projects.description:
•	Designed an Arena simulation of PetSmart’s distribution center in order to create an improved model of their inspection process to drastically increase savings.  
•	Validated the Arena model of PetSmart’s current system by using a paired T test, resulting in no significant difference between their real system and the models’ predictions.

projects.title: Arizona State University: Information Systems Database course, Database Design, 2012
projects.description:
•	Used Access and VB.NET to design a database with user interface to run various queries for a sample hospital company. 
•	Created an entity-relationship diagram and later transformed it into a relational data model to optimize the database.
